meta.goal: Make the mcts-agent visualizer export a gif and/or video file
meta.initial_state: The visualizer is visualizer.html in this folder. It renders an MCTS search tree with D3.js. We need to add client-side export to GIF and/or Video files.

events.state: The visualizer is visualizer.html in this folder. It renders an MCTS search tree with D3.js. We need to add client-side export to GIF and/or Video files.

candidates: Inspect visualizer.html to analyze the current D3.js animation loop, rendering pipeline, and search tree playback controls.
Add client-side export libraries such as gif.js and CCapture.js or configure the native MediaRecorder API via script tags.
Implement a frame capture pipeline that converts the D3 SVG tree state into an HTML5 canvas during step-by-step tree expansion.
Add recording UI controls with start, stop, format selection (GIF/Video), and a progress indicator.
Assemble recorded frames into a downloadable GIF or WebM file and trigger the client-side file download.
